title: Parkour Polygon
description:
Run, jump, and scale the city walls! 



Parkour Polygon is a throwback platformer inspired by classics like Super Meat Boy and the Super Mario series. Set against the striking neon moonlight, you must navigate the rooftops of a sci-fi city to reach your destination, dodging hazards as you go.





Features:



-Leap from building to building in a fast-paced platforming rush!



-Use the environment; jump off of signs in the background to reach new distances!



-Over 20 levels tuned to test your platforming prowess.



-A stunning synthwave soundtrack by James "Nihilore" Opie



-Test your skill and endurance in Endless Mode; see how far you can go...with just one life!
description_short: Dodge hazards, climb walls, and kick off of signs in your rush to the flag! Parkour Polygon delivers a 2D parkour experience with a striking minimalist style.
